reason: Two grand up front plus 249 a month is over 5,000 $ the first year, and I'm already booked solid off my cell and voicemail. I only look at my phone at lunch and at six anyway, so getting a text right away doesn't change much for me.
objection: I can't see the return. Most people who need me leave a voicemail or call back, and I don't know how many jobs I'm really losing, so 1,999.99 $ setup on top of the monthly feels like paying a lot to fix a problem I can't measure.
would_change_my_mind: Drop the setup fee, or give me a free month on my real line so I can count the jobs it actually catches that I would have lost.
